subject.title: feat(runtime): show OpenClaw sessions in Live Activity

question: Should OpenClaw core own this env-gated Command Center activity lease POST, or should runtime activity flow through the canonical Gateway/session activity contract or a Command Center/plugin-owned integration?
rationale: The change adds new operator env surface, external metadata egress, and a parallel activity contract while the canonical per-session activity issue remains open, so automation cannot choose the permanent product boundary safely.

options.title: Use Canonical Activity Contract
options.body: Route this work through the Gateway/session activity contract or an approved narrow subset before Command Center consumes it.

options.title: Accept Core Env Emitter
options.body: Maintainers can deliberately accept a core-owned env-gated POST path after approving the privacy, schema, and operator setup contract.

options.title: Move Outside Core
options.body: If this is Command Center-specific integration behavior, move it to a plugin or owner package that consumes supported runtime/Gateway activity seams.

recommendation.title: Use Canonical Activity Contract
recommendation.body: Route this work through the Gateway/session activity contract or an approved narrow subset before Command Center consumes it.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the strongest current signal for the canonical activity-contract decision and recent adjacent Gateway/session work.
